applicability: Marketplace Portal service. Policy edition 2026-09-01. Collection Profile and CORE terms are separate.
content:
Check whether the customer has the self-service migration feature. If it is unavailable, submit a support request identifying the proposed transfer.

Supported relationship categories include employment, people working for the same company, ownership/shareholding relationships, companies with the same legal representative, a person and a company for which that person is the legal representative, and an actual transfer of the store.

Open Store/Collection Management → Store migration management → Migrate store. Access to the page does not establish relationship eligibility; identify the relationship before submitting the migration.

## Migration history

The All records view includes incoming and outgoing migrations, the initiating and receiving names/accounts, store count, processing time and status. Search by date, status, name or account.

Statuses include initiating, processing, receiving party declined, awaiting confirmation, cancelled and completed. A migration under way is separate from a completed migration, and a store cannot be closed while its migration remains in progress.
